name: Dreame L10s Ultra (US)

radios.note: No Wi-Fi band statement found in the pages we saw.

matter.note: No Matter statement found on Dreame pages or a CSA listing.

apple_home.note: One Dreame page lists Siri via the Dreamehome app; that is voice control, not confirmed Home app support.

google_home.note: Dreame lists Google Assistant voice control.

smartthings.note: No Dreame or Samsung page found for SmartThings.

home_assistant.note: No official Home Assistant page; only a community HACS integration lists the L10s Ultra.

hubRequired.note: The self-empty base is not a hub.

localControl.note: No maker statement on local-only control found.

cleaning.note: Vacuums and mops with two spinning mops.

navigation.note: Dreame's wording: dual lasers, an RGB camera and AI for mapping, navigation and obstacle avoidance. Its comparison table calls it 'Double laser+AI'.

suctionPa.note: Dreame says the figure is from its lab tests.

selfEmptying.note: The base empties the bin into a 3 L dust bag, up to 60 days.

summary: Dreame lists the L10s Ultra as a vacuum and mop with 5,300 Pa suction and a base that empties the bin into a dust bag. It supports Alexa and Google Assistant voice control. No Matter support was found.
